about: A small, streaming HTTP client for Node.js.

prs.title: Redirects give their connection back
prs.broken: After following a redirect, the first response was never read, so its connection stayed busy. Scripts hung for 30 seconds before exiting, and limited connection pools stopped answering.
prs.changed: The redirect response is now drained before following it.
prs.matters: Scripts exit right away, and apps with a connection limit keep working.
